title: Experiment job envelope v1
description: What a submitter asks a queue to run for one arm and instance (or shard) of a frozen experiment.protocol/v1. It is compiled into the backend's own spec (taskq.task-spec/v1, isolab.job/v1, spotlab.job/v1, a spot-system jobs.json entry) by the table in README.md; the backend measures, the envelope binds the measurement to the protocol and fixes what a checkpoint and a restore mean for the rows that come back.

job_id.description: <protocol_id>/<arm>/<instance>[/<shard>]; also the backend idempotency key, so a resubmission returns the first task.

sha256.description: freeze.protocol_sha256 of the frozen protocol; a draft protocol is refused.

measurement_class.description: measurement: a clock or counter is read against an A/A interval, so the job needs an isolated host and is never resumed. The others finish cheaply, on spot capacity, and checkpoint.

repo.description: An alias in the worker's allowlist, never a URL.

commit.description: Pushed. A worker checks out exactly this commit.

image_digest.description: For image-based backends (isolab-k8s): the immutable digest that holds the binary; the source commit then records provenance only.

argv.description: No shell. Placeholders {out}, {checkpoint}, {seed}, {shard} are substituted by the compiler from the envelope and the protocol's seed table.

verify.description: The backend's independent certificate check (taskq verify.builtin certificate, isolab verify.builtin taskq-certificate, or an argv exiting 0 verified / 1 refuted / 2 no claim).

instance_families.description: Pin families when a CRIU image must restore on the same CPU feature set.

timeout_seconds.description: Wall budget of useful work across all attempts; waiting for capacity and checkpoint grace are not charged to it.

max_attempts.description: Infrastructure attempts only (worker lost, checkout failed, preemption). A non-zero exit or a timeout is an outcome.

grace_seconds.description: The window the job gets after SIGTERM to commit a generation; must fit inside the pod's terminationGracePeriodSeconds, which must fit inside the provider's notice (AWS: 120 s, best effort).

store.description: Durable prefix for generations: s3://bucket/taskq/ckpt/<job_id>/ or a ReadWriteMany PVC path. Never a node-local path alone.

image_budget_mb.description: Refuse to admit a job whose RSS would not dump inside grace_seconds at the measured dump rate.

out.description: Where export.json (experiment.export/v1) is written, beside the raw records, never inside a sealed session.

labels.description: Provenance the queue stores opaquely: protocol_id, protocol_sha256, arm, instance, experiment, goal, submitted_by.
